title: Exactly what I was looking for
text: Exactly what I was looking for. I added this to my home office to keep my exercise equipment in to use during some breaks from the computer - get some movement in and maintain good form.  It holds plenty of things and keeps it neatly tucked away.  It is sturdy, heavy in weight  that someone can sit on the cushioned  top that acts like a seat.  I would have preferred some different variety  options in terms of design/color but it happens to match my office setting nicely.  I would recommend this product.

description: This classic square ottoman offered in a global inspired suzani pattern creates a bold impact for any room. The bright multi-colored pattern on a cream background with tufting is complemented by wood legs in a rustic brown finish. Our square storage ottoman will add functional style to any space. Use it to store extra pillows or blankets in a bedroom, hide toys or controllers in the family room, or conceal accessories in an entryway. Pair two ottomans together and double the impact. The lift-off lid enables easy access to storage within. No assembly required; spot clean as needed.
